summary_en: This study tests HB0036, a drug sponsored by Shanghai Huaota Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., in people with advanced solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer. HB0036 is given as an intravenous infusion every 3 weeks, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study evaluates safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and efficacy, and it is a Phase I/II study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa HB0036, un fármaco patrocinado por Shanghai Huaota Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. HB0036 se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, y la duración del tratamiento no está especificada. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia, y es un estudio de fase I/II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced or recurrent solid tumor that progressed after standard therapy (Phase I).
Phase II: advanced non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 TPS of 1% or higher and no actionable markers such as EGFR or ALK.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting test results within 14 days of first dose.
not_for: Phase II: prior simultaneous therapy with a PD-1 pathway inhibitor and a TIGIT inhibitor.
Autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy within the past 2 years, with some exceptions.
History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis (except from radiotherapy).
Clinically active brain or meningeal metastases.
Positive HIV test or active hepatitis B or C.
